nodes.text: Meanwhile, the Department of Health (DOH) spokesperson Albert Domingo reported on January 8 that the Philippines recorded 284 HMPV cases last year but assured the public that no lockdowns or border closures are needed as the virus is seasonal and widespread globally. (3/4)
